title: Rule-RuleSet-Name
description: JSON schema for creating or updating a Pega ruleset name record (Rule-RuleSet-Name). This is an infrastructure rule type with no class association and no ruleset version. Only authored and identity fields are included; system-managed fields are omitted.

pyRuleSetName.description: The canonical ruleset name (mixed case). Only alphanumeric, dash, and underscore characters are allowed; spaces are auto-stripped by the server.

pyLabel.description: Human-readable display label shown in Dev Studio.

pyDescription.description: Developer-facing description of the ruleset's purpose.

pyUsage.description: Brief usage note. For branch rulesets, set to the full branch ruleset name.

pyRuleSetType.description: Category of ruleset: STANDARD (normal application), BRANCH (parallel development), PEGA/PEGAFW (platform-owned), OVERRIDE (override ruleset), COMPONENT/SHARED (component framework).

pyLayerClassification.description: Classification for rule resolution layer. 'Standard' for custom rulesets, 'Pega' for platform rulesets, '' for unclassified.

pyUseCheckOut.description: Require checkout before editing rules in this ruleset. Auto-set to 'false' for override rulesets.

pyIsTestRuleSet.description: 'true' for test-only rulesets excluded from production packaging.

pyLocalRuleSet.description: 'true' for rulesets scoped to a single node (rarely used).

pyAppBasedValidation.description: Enable application-based rule validation. Auto-reset to 'false' for SHARED and COMPONENT rulesets.

pyApprovalClass.description: Case class used for rule check-in approval workflow. Typically 'Work-RuleCheckIn'.

pyApprovalFlow.description: Flow used for rule approval routing. Must resolve to a valid Rule-Obj-Flow instance. Typically 'ApproveRuleChanges'.

pyBaseRule.description: 'true' for branch rulesets and some base/root platform rulesets. 'false' or absent for most standard rulesets.

pyBranchID.description: Branch identifier (short name within the parent ruleset). Only for BRANCH rulesets.

pyBranchOrigin.description: Parent (base) ruleset this branch was created from. Only for BRANCH rulesets.

pyRuleSet.description: Self-referential — always equals pyRuleSetName. The server forces this on save.

pyRuleSetVersion.description: Always empty for Rule-RuleSet-Name (not versioned in the normal sense).
